title: Align Drug Database UI with backend drug lists and refresh/verification results

requirements.summary: Update Drug Database UI to use backend-provided Approved/Banned/All lists consistently; ensure Refresh & Verify refreshes data and shows a clear verification banner; keep counters, search/filter/pagination, and CSV export operating on the currently filtered dataset without runtime errors.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Drug Database module, the Approved tab shows only approved drugs from the backend and the Banned tab shows only banned drugs from the backend.
After clicking “Refresh & Verify”, the table data refreshes and the verification banner displays a clear pass/fail summary based on the refreshed data.
The counters (Total, Approved, Banned) match the current backend dataset returned by `getAllDrugs()` and update after refresh.
Search, category filtering, pagination, and CSV export operate on the filtered dataset without runtime errors when fields are missing or empty.

file_operations.description: Ensure the drug database React Query hooks are wired so the UI can reliably use backend lists for All/Approved/Banned; update the Refresh & Verify mutation to invalidate and refetch drug-list queries (all/approved/banned) and the last verification query after a successful refresh so counters, tabs, and banners update immediately.

Align tab behavior with backend lists by using `useGetAllDrugs`, `useGetApprovedDrugs`, and `useGetBannedDrugs` as the authoritative sources for each tab (rather than filtering only from the all list). Ensure counters derive from `getAllDrugs()` results. Update Refresh & Verify flow to refresh the table by triggering query invalidations and to render a clear pass/fail verification banner computed from the latest backend `DrugVerificationResult` (and keep existing defensive handling for missing/empty fields across search, category filtering, pagination, and CSV export).
